title: Why Streeman picked him for bass
summary: He explains Streeman knew he owned a bass and was practicing at home.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well, he knew I had a bass at the house that I'd been working out on. Because I told him when I bought the bass, I said, I bought me a string bass, Al. I'm practicing at the house. And I had no idea that the bass player was ever going to quit. And he was a good friend of mine, a fine bass player. I knew he worked for an oil company, you know. But I just bought the bass because I liked the bass. That's all. And I wanted to try to learn the bass. I had a job. I wasn't worrying about the job. I was playing guitar in the band. I wasn't trying to take nobody's job.
I was trying to take a job. Yeah. No, I just can't figure out why he wanted you on bass on that particular instrument rather
than guitar. Well, I guess he thought he would give me an opportunity to play the bass. Oh, yeah. Because he knew I had one and was practicing at the house.
